_about: More weapons for the sandbox (decision 0016): a staff and a wand for each of the three elements, so they are told apart by shape and not only by a coloured stone; and ten more arms. Described as solid shapes with no glow, which 3D generation handles.

subjects.subject: A fire wizard's staff: a thick straight dark red-brown wooden pole, at the top a solid opaque orange-red stone shaped like a fat flame held in a blackened iron claw, bands of dark iron along the pole. The weapon stands perfectly upright, shown whole from pommel to tip, chunky solid shapes, no glow, no transparency, no chains, no thin strings, no tassels.

An ice wizard's staff: a thick straight pale grey wooden pole, at the top a solid opaque pale blue crystal shaped like a blunt faceted icicle held in a silver ring, white fur-free wrapped leather grip. The weapon stands perfectly upright, shown whole from pommel to tip, chunky solid shapes, no glow, no transparency, no chains, no thin strings, no tassels.
